title: Psychedelic Crystal Ball
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a metallic base inscribed with 'SLOT-24-SEVIN-78400'. Inside the orb, two large pomegranate-like orbs connected by bright blue energy pulses radiate colorful, organic, tentacle-like forms in pink, purple, green and blue. Two small figures in red coats stand on a pink cobblestone floor facing a dark central doorway with a green glowing figure.
prompt: A surreal glowing crystal ball on a dark pedestal with gold text reading SLOT-24-SEVIN-78400.
